description: This Dart source file defines the NotificationsRepository class, which manages local notifications stored in SharedPreferences. It provides methods to load, save, add, mark as read, and clear notifications, utilizing JSON encoding/decoding for persistence.

classes.name: NotificationsRepository
classes.description: A repository class responsible for managing local notification data stored in SharedPreferences. Provides methods to load, save, add, mark as read, and clear notification entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of notifications from SharedPreferences, decoding from JSON. Returns an empty list if no data is found.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided list of NotificationItems into SharedPreferences after encoding to JSON.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new notification item to the start of the list and saves the updated list.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a notification as read by its ID, updating the stored list accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all stored notifications from SharedPreferences.
